records.text:
Gamillan attacks have left Earth teetering on the
brink of destruction. Trusting Starsha's offer of
Iscandarian aid, humanity constructs a ship
capable of making the 168,000 light-year journey
to Iscandar: the Space Battleship Yamato.
Our hero, piloting the mysterious VangRay, ends up
interceding when Gamillans attack the Yamato, and
then joins the crew. So their long journey begins.

Gamillan attacks have left Earth teetering on the
brink of destruction. Trusting Sasha's offer of
Iscandarian aid, humanity constructs a ship
capable of making the 168,000 light-year journey
to Iscandar: the Space Battleship Yamato.
Our hero, piloting the mysterious VangRay, ends up
interceding when Gamillans attack the Yamato, and
then joins the crew. So their long journey begins.

Huckebein and Grungust were developed with the
sole purpose of opposing Gamillas. Their pilots
attempted to lend their strength to the Yamato.

The crew ventures to Mars in order to obtain
necessary parts for warp navigation. There they
are attacked by the Jupiter Empire, whom they
believed already destroyed. In the middle of the
battle, Tobia of the Space Pirates Crossbone
Vanguard appears. With his help, Jupiter's forces
are crushed. Tobia offers to guide the crew to
Jupiter, and they leave the red planet behind.

The crew arrives at Jupiter after a successful
first warp. Tobia takes a scouting party down to
an Empire base, where they must battle a mobile
suit bearing the Bio Brain of the legendary ace
pilot, Amuro Ray. With Kincade's help and Tobia's
clever maneuvering, they secure a narrow victory.
The Jupiter Empire is finished, but a Gamillan
base is discovered on the gas giant.

The Yamato launches an attack on the Gamillan base
on a floating Jovian continent. VangRay's OS,
System Nine-Nine, awakens during that battle.
Yamato destroys the enemy flagship, but even more
hostiles flood the scene. Okita decides to employ
the wave motion gun, resulting in the destruction
of the entire continent along with the base. The
crew is horrified by the weapon's deadly power.

The crew turns towards Enceladus, one of Saturn's
moons, in order to gather materials needed to
repair the wave motion engine. There, Kodai finds
the wreckage of the Destroyer Yukikaze that his
brother Mamoru captained. Metal Beasts attack
them, but they are saved by the Black Getter and
the Great Mazinger. The crew is shocked to learn
that those pilots are from an alternate dimension.

In order to put an end to the Planet Bombs raining
to Earth, the crew sets out to destroy Gamillas'
Pluto Frontline Base. The Yamato nearly falls to
Commander Shultz's secret weapon, the Reflection
Satellite Cannon, but the mobile units are able to
successfully shut down the base. Shultz's fellow
Zaltzians risk their lives so he can escape,
though the Yamato destroys them and the base.

The crew holds a line-crossing celebration as they
leave the Solar System. Shultz attacks, trapping
them between a gaseous life form and a star. The
Yamato seems doomed when Setsuna and Tieria appear
to help. The Yamato manages to escape using wave
motion gun tactics. After the battle, Setsuna and
Tieria learn they've been transported to another
dimension and join the crew.

The Yamato finds itself in a dimensional rift
after a warp malfunction. A Gamillan ship is there
as well; they send Melda as a messenger to propose
that they work together to escape. Despite being
attacked by unidentified craft and trouble on the
Gamillan ship, they escape the rift—right into the
clutches of a Gamillan fleet. A dimensional quake
interrupts the battle, consuming the Yamato.

The dimensional quake transports our heroes to
an alternate Earth, one that looks nothing like
a planet on the brink of destruction. As they
learn more about the situation, villainous robots
attack the town. A strange girl leads our hero to
the VangRay while Gaine of the Brave Express Corps
fights the fiends. Our hero helps Maito repel the
scoundrels, but is arrested by the police.

Maito has vouched for our hero, but his warm
welcome is interrupted by another attack by the
villainous robots. Maito and Gaine unite into
Mightgaine, crushing the enemy. In the middle of
battle, our hero learns that the girl from the
previous fight is actually the VangRay's OS,
System Nine-Nine, and decides to call her "Nine."

Having learned what became of the Yamato from
Nine, our hero and Maito set out, but are attacked
by Hokushin's Six. A mysterious man named Akito
and the Nadesico Squad help them fend off the Six.
Jovian survivors claiming to be Martian Successors
declare war on the Earth Federation. Finally,
among the intel Akito discovered are images that
show the Yamato has been captured by the Jovians.

The Yamato finds itself in a dimensional rift
after a warp malfunction. A Gamillan ship is there
as well; they send Melda as a messenger to propose
that they work together to escape. Despite being
attacked by unidentified craft and trouble on the
Gamillan ship, they escape the rift—right into the
clutches of a Gamillan fleet. A dimensional quake
interrupts the battle, consuming the Yamato.

The dimensional quake transports our heroes to an
alternate Earth, one that looks nothing like a
planet on the brink of destruction. As they learn
more about the situation, villainous robots
terrorize the town. A strange girl leads our hero
to the VangRay while the Nadesico Squad battles
the villains. After defeating the terrorists, our
hero accepts guidance from Ruri.

Ryoko engages the terrorists attacking the
Federation base and is saved by her former friend,
Akito. The Nadesico Squad rushes to the scene;
with Maito and Gaine's help, they are able to
defeat the terrorists. In the middle of battle,
our hero learns that the girl from the previous
fight is actually the VangRay's OS, System Nine-
Nine, and decides to call her "Nine."

Having learned what became of the Yamato from
Nine, our hero and Maito set out, but are attacked
by the Shadow Army. Maito is able to stave their
attackers off using the Mightgaine. Afterwards,
Jovian survivors claiming to be Martian Successors
declare war on the Earth Federation. Finally,
among the intel Akito discovered are images that
show the Yamato has been captured by the Jovians.

As Ruri gathers a force to oppose the warmongering
Martian Successors, she ponders contacting
Celestial Being. Criminals join forces with the
Martian Successors to attack the Nadesico Squad,
but, as Ruri predicted, Celestial Being appears to
help, as well as Tobia, who had gotten caught in a
dimensional quake. They decide to form an alliance
in order to defeat the Martian Successors.

The crew heads to the forbidden sea, Area D, where
they run into a group of unmanned craft and
Dragons. During battle, Assault Landing Submarine
Tuatha de Danaan appears from another world, and 
the Para-Mail Squad also shows up in order to help
fight the Dragons. Meanwhile, it's discovered that
Princess Angelise is a Norma; she is tortured on
Arzenal and stripped of her title and position.

Forced to become a Para-Mail Rider, Ange is sent
into battle with Dragons; she panics, causing her
unit to suffer major losses. Ange nearly dies in
another battle with the Dragons, but recovers her
will to live thanks to Judau's guidance. This
awakens the mysterious Para-Mail Villkiss.
After the battle, she vows to fight to protect
life itself.

Ruri decides to split their forces in two: one
to fight the Dragons, and the other to fight
the Martian Successors and their allies.
Just then, they receive reports that Ange's
Villkiss has crashed, and her whereabouts are
unknown.

Ange washes up on a deserted island after crashing
and is rescued by a strange young man called Tusk.
Little by little, his kindness makes her begin to
trust him. Dragons attack, and Ange fights them in
the repaired Villkiss together with Athrun, who
had come to rescue her. After the battle, Ange
returns to Arzenal with her companions, though she
is loathe to leave Tusk behind.

Momoka, Ange's former attendant, sneaks aboard
the flight back to Arzenal. She pledges her
undying loyalty to Ange, but Ange rejects her. The
Para-Mail First Squad's incessant squabbles over
pay calm down when Sumeragi hires them on for a
job. After the battle, Ange buys Momoka, thus
saving her from being punished for stowing away.

Ange still opposes Hilde and ends up provoking her
rage after discovering Salia's secret. On top of
everything, Ange catches a cold. The squad has a
tough time fighting a new kind of Dragon without
Ange, but they are saved when she and Kira sortie
despite her cold. The spared squad receives a
large bounty for defeating the new Dragons and
come together under Salia's command.

The crew returns to Nouvelle Tokyo City, where
they ask former Nadesico crew for the Nadesico
Squad's help. Meanwhile, Japan suffers a rash of
natto thefts that is due to a grudge that Vuitton
holds against the food. They struggle to defeat
her, but are saved by Ryoko, who has teamed up
with Hikaru and Izumu. Thus is Vuitton defeated
and the natto crisis averted.

The Jin family is disturbed by the losses Kappei
and the others sustained in battle. Ruri reunites
with them and Akito, but they are attacked by
Hokushin, who is after Akito. Seeing Akito fight
all alone, Kappei shakes off his sadness and fear,
deciding to use the Zambot 3 to fight once again.
After driving off the Martian Successors, Ruri and
the group learn what happened to Akito and Yurika.

Desperate to defeat Mightgaine, Wolfgang gives
the Hiryu to Joe the Ace, who challenges Maito
to battle. The Tri Bomber fights in Maito's stead
and is torn apart by the Hiryu. Having obtained
Meganoid technology, Wolfgang appears, but is
defeated when Daitarn 3 and Great Mazinger join
the fray. Though the group wins, they lose the Tri
Bomber due to the damage it sustained in battle.

In order to defeat the Mightgaine, Hoi copied its
Super AI to create the Black Gaine. A sense of
justice was copied too, causing the Black Gaine
to join the Brave Express Corps, but Hoi forces it
to fight against Maito and the others. Black Gaine
regains its sense of justice after Maito destroys
the control system; it swears to one day rejoin
the Brave Express Corps.

Wolfgang, Vuitton, Mifune, Hoi, and Joe form the
DG Alliance under Mr. X's direction and attack the
crew. Disgusted by Hoi's underhanded tactics, Joe
forms a temporary truce with Maito, and together
with Graham, Colasour, and Battle Bomber, joins
the fight against the DG Alliance. Maito's resolve
to fight Joe only increases, while Hoi is driven
out of the group by Purple.

As the group ascends to space to fight the Martian
Successors, they are attacked by Ghuli, a soldier
of Gardim. A conflict with Nine and Ghuli's
speed puts our hero in dire straights, but Ryoma,
Kincade, and Kodai, who escaped from the captured
Yamato, save the day. In order to free the Yamato,
they head for Terminal Colony Amaterasu, the
Martian Successors' base.

As the group ascends to space to fight the Martian
Successors, they are attacked by Ghuli, a soldier
of Gardim. A conflict with Nine and Ghuli's speed
puts our hero in dire straights, but Ryoma,
Kincade, and Kodai, who escaped from the captured
Yamato, save the day. In order to free the Yamato,
they head for Terminal Colony Amaterasu, the
Martian Successors' base.

The crew clash with the Martian Successors on
Amaterasu. Nadesico B succeeds in a deadly Boson
Jump and is able to paralyze Amaterasu using the
virus that Sanada programmed. Akito and Banjo
break in and discover the ν Gundam and Amuro.
With the Yamato freed and the Earth Sphere base
destroyed, Akito and the crew make their way to
the Successors' stronghold on Mars.

The battle with the Martian Successors at the Mars
Polar Cap Ruins grows chaotic with the appearance
of Dragons and Gardim. Akito, desperate to save
Yurika, leads the crew to victory, but a clash
between Red and Black Para-Mail forces traps them
in yet another predicament. Then, as Yurika
awakens, a strange phenomenon occurs that causes
the crew to vanish into thin air.

The strange phenomenon transports the crew to the
Earth with red seas where Amuro and the others
were. They have no time to recover from the shock
before being drawn into a battle between Neo Zeon
and the Federation. A Gamillan fleet destroys them
and turns its sights to the Yamato. Okita's
determination leads them to victory, but they end
up worse for the wear.

They name the three dimensions the Yamato has
traveled: the New Correct Century dimension, the
AD dimension, and the Universal Century dimension.
They learn all they can about the history of the
UC dimension they are in currently. Thinking on
their situation and how best to proceed, Okita
debates whether or not to contact Londo Bell, the
organization to which Amuro and Tessa belong.

A number of unfortunate events drives Banagher to
fight Neo Zeon using the Unicorn Gundam in order
to protect his friends aboard the Nahel Argama.
The crew, having decided to contact Londo Bell,
makes their appearance, but Gamillans allied with
Neo Zeon attack. The crew defends against them and
heads to the Nahel Argama; Amuro, Hathaway, and
the others are delighted to see their old friends.

Upset by something Audrey said, Banagher becomes
trapped in NT-D during a battle with Neo Zeon,
which causes the Unicorn to go berserk. With
Setsuna's help and Judau's guidance, Banagher is
able to recover himself, take control of NT-D,
and master Destroy Mode. With Ra Cailum and Ple's
assistance, the crew is able to defeat Neo Zeon's
commander, Full Frontal.

In a plot to seize control of Londo Bell,
Federation Command dispatches G-Hound, who subdues
the Nahel Argama with the help of a previously
installed agent, Daguza. As Neo Zeon and Amalgam
approach, Banagher is able to convince Daguza to
relinquish the Nahel Argama so they can fight.
However, Riddhe absconds with Audrey in the middle
of battle.

The crew decides to descend to the Earth with red
seas in order to ascertain the situation for
themselves. There, they learn that Gamillas has
allied with Neo Zeon. Determined to fight them,
Okita decides to join forces with G-Hound and the
Nahel Argama. After a successful battle against
Neo Zeon, the crew considers their role in this
world and decide to ally with Londo Bell.

G-Hound may have allied with the crew in the
previous battle, but Command still wants Londo
Bell's power and so order Daguza to take over the
Nahel Argama. Banagher and the others manage to
convince Daguza to give up control of the Nahel
Argama again, so G-Hound attacks Londo Bell. The
crew is able to chase off G-Hound with Ra Cailum's
help and then head to Melida Island.

Amalgam and Neo Zeon attack the crew on Melida
Island. Locked in struggle with Full Frontal,
Banagher becomes trapped in NT-D, causing the
Unicorn to go berserk. With Setsuna's help and
Judau's guidance, Banagher is able to recover
himself, take control of NT-D, and master Destroy
Mode. However, Riddhe absconds with Audrey in the
middle of battle.

Shinji tries to fend off an Angel attacking NERV,
but Eva Unit-01 goes berserk. The Mazinger Z and
others stop the Eva, and Shinji and Rei fight the
Angel and Dragons once more.
After the battle, Tetsuya demands that Ryoma
come with him; when Ryoma refuses, Tetsuya leaves
the group on his own.

Baron Ashura and several Dragons attack the crew,
but Koji, Ryoma, and Ange launch counterattacks.
Tetsuya reappears as their enemy. Though reluctant
to fight, the Mazinger Z is upgraded with new
weapons, Ryoma boards the Shin Getter with
Hayabusa and Benkei, and Ange awakens new powers
in the Villkiss. After the battle, the crew learn
there may be a way to return to the AD dimension.

Sousuke returns to Jindai High School for the
first time in a while. Ange is exhausted after
days of training. Unfortunate circumstances lead
Bonta-kun and Likitee to battle in the school.
Amalgam chooses that moment to attack, but Bonta-
kun and Ange are able to fight them off. After the
battle, Sousuke, Shinji, and the others spend some
long-overdue quality time with their friends.

As preparations are made for a Parallel Boson
Jump, the crew splits into two groups: one in
charge of dealing with the UC dimension and the
other in charge of returning to the AD dimension.
The AD dimension group is able to cross over
dimensional barriers thanks to the Parallel Boson
Jump.

Sousuke takes Kaname to Jindai High to help calm
her down. There, they encounter Leonard, who has
become Amalgam's leader. Sousuke is defeated by
the overwhelming power of Leonard's Belial, and
the Arbalest is destroyed. Having joined Amalgam,
Kalinin betrays Mithril during the battle and
captures Kaname before leaving with Leonard.

Ryoma and the others head out to protect Atami
from Dr. Hell's attacking armies. With the Getter
Rays suppressed by the Dragons, the fight takes a
turn for the worse—until Ryoma remembers the
quintessence of Getter and draws out the power of
the Shin Getter. While the others celebrate their
victory over Brocken and the Dragons, Sayaka
worries the Mazinger's power is consuming Koji.

The crew clashes with G-Hound when they try to
seize an Eva. When an Angel appears, G-Hound,
Tetsuya, and even Neo Zeon ally with the crew to
fend it off. With Asuka and Shinji's help, they
defeat it and save the world. Amuro and the others
take this cooperation between enemies as a sign
that a glimmer of hope yet remains.

Banagher and Hathaway are captured by Neo Zeon,
who are targeting the Dakar Council. They meet
Loni and learn of the hatred that simmers within
her. Loni and Ple Twelve are consumed by machines
and go berserk. Sousuke returns in a new mech
called the Laevatein and defeats his long-time
enemy, Gauron. Banagher and the others defend
Dakar successfully, vowing to put an end to war.

The crew launches an attack on the Federation base
and G-Hound in order to rescue Marida and Audrey.
Banagher and Riddhe argue during the battle, but
manage to save Marida and Audrey. The girls leave
with Kamille. The crew is able to repel Gardim,
and they learn that the Nadesico Squad has
returned to the Universal Century dimension from
the AD dimension.

During a party welcoming the crew back to the AD
dimension, Joe challenges Maito to a duel. Joe's
disregard for justice causes Maito to lose heart,
and the Mightgaine suffers major damage. Then
Mifune appears, targeting the Zambot 3; among his
followers is Kocho, whose love for Hamada causes
her to forget her duty. Maito defeats Joe and
crushes Mifune's ambition with Kappei and Banjo.

Hokushin demands a one-on-one fight with Akito.
Having recovered his trust in his friends, Akito
is able to see through the trap. Nadesico C and
Yurika appear to help. Combined with Akatsuki's
efforts, they are able to defeat the Martian
Successors once and for all. With Yurika safe and
things with Hokushin settled, Akito decides to
abandon revenge to live life with his friends.

Ange wants to save her sister, Sylvia; Hilda wants
to return to her home. Together, they desert
Arzenal. However, the execution turns out to be a
trap set by her brother Julio; Ange is publicly
denounced and sentenced to death. She is rescued
by Tusk and returns to the Nadesico Squad, vowing
to destroy this world with Hilda. The crew then
makes a shocking discovery: Vivian is a Dragon.

Jill tells the crew the truth about Dragons, Mana,
and Norma, and urges them to go forward with the
plan to cooperate with Libertus. Ange refuses.
Salamandinay attacks Arzenal with a captured
Dragon. The battle between Villkiss and Enryugo
causes a dimensional distortion that transports
Ange, Tusk, and Vivian to the Universal Century
dimension.

Salamandinay, who'd protected Ange and the others,
reveals they have been fighting to get Aura back,
and asks for help. Ange refuses at first, but
eventually grows close to Salamandinay. Embryo
suddenly appears and vows to attack Arzenal. Ange
pursues Embryo back to the AD dimension. Salia and
the others disappear during the fighting, and Ange
and the others return to the UC dimension.

The crew prepares for the Eighth Angel's attack,
Embryo brings Joe and the DG Alliance back from
the AD dimension, but Maito defeats them by
combining the Mightgaine and Might Kaiser into
the Great Mightgaine. With Joe's help, Maito
shoots down the Eighth Angel, and the three Evas
work together to destroy its core.

Our hero and Nine decide to make time to talk
one-on-one and so grow ever closer. However,
our hero is injured by Ghuli, and the VangRay is
destroyed in an attack carried out by Gardim's
commander, Jamie. Nine gives our hero a new mech
that was constructed in secret, with which our
hero finally destroys Ghuli.

Our hero and Nine decide to make time to talk
one-on-one and so grow ever closer. However,
Ghuli appears, and the VangRay is destroyed in an
attack carried out by Gardim's commander, Jamie.
Nine gives our hero a new mech that was
constructed in secret, with which our hero finally
destroys Ghuli.

The crew heads into space in order to prevent Neo
Zeon's Colony Drop. Leonard and Embryo appear with
Kaname, Salia, and the others in tow. The crew
fights together with Mineva and Kamille, and the
colony is destroyed by their Colony Laser. The
crew jumps to Axis in order to evade the laser, 
where they find Inez, an ex-member of Nadesico.

As a representative of Laplace, an organization
whose ultimate goal is to end the long war between
Spacenoids and Earthnoids, Mineva gives the crew
the Colony Laser and the Calculation Unit. G-Hound
and Neo Zeon appear to destroy Laplace and the
crew, but Kamille and the others hold them off.
Full Frontal leaves, but only after uttering
something ominous.

Velt and Lottie encounter Gardim while they're out
alone on a reconnaissance mission. Both of their
mech's limiters are broken in the struggle.

G-Hound seizes control of the Colony Laser, Dr.
Hell's large-scale invasion begins, and Embryo and
Leonard's alliance produces utterly unexpected
results. The crew splits into three groups in
order to deal with all that happens.

The crew battles with Ashura, Brocken, and Dr.
Hell when they attack the Photonic Power Research
Institute. The Hell King Gordon that Dr. Hell
controls is defeated by the crew, aided by the
hidden Science Fortress Lab and the Mazinger Z's
newly awakened power. Ashura reveals Dr. Hell's
true intentions and his own schemes, sacrificing
himself to summon the Gods of Mycenae.

Faced with the overwhelming power of the Mycenae
Gods and Hades, the decision is made to abandon
the Science Fortress Laboratory. Joe allies with
the crew so he can defeat his enemy, but even so,
they cannot match Hades' power. However, the
Mazinger Z transforms into the Mazinger Zero using
Mazin Power and defeats Hades. Koji loses control
of the Mazinger Zero and disappears.

The crew battles with G-Hound for control of the
Colony Laser. Riddhe yearns to defeat Banagher,
but he comes back to himself thanks to Marida and
rejoins Londo Bell. The crew gains the advantage
in the fight against G-Hound, but not before the
Colony Laser is prepped to fire. Desperate to
prevent this, Banagher destroys the laser.

The group clashes with Neo Zeon over Laplace's
Box, which can either extinguish the flames of war
or fan them. During battle, Banagher and Amuro
help Full Frontal realize he's been trapped by
Char's curse. Mineva learns the truth about the
Box and realizes how pointless it is to let the
past dictate the future. Together, she and Frontal
decide to put an end to the war.

Salia and the others swear allegiance to Embryo
and return to the AD dimension. Jill is determined
to help Libertus succeed, even if it means
sacrificing friends. Ange parts ways with her, but
loses Momoka and Tusk and ends up falling into
Embryo's clutches. She is brought to the Holy
Misurugi Empire, where fellow captives Cagalli and
Marina inform her she is to be Embryo's bride.

The crew invades the Misurugi Empire to save Ange
and rescue Aura from the Pillar of Dawn. Ange
escapes in the midst of battle. Sousuke rescues
Kaname from Leonard. Ersha, Chris, and Salia
realize, thanks to Rosalie and Jill, that Embryo
has deceived them. The crew defeats Embryo,
rescues Aura, and crushes Embryo's plans to
destroy the world.

The crew battles the 9th and 10th Angels, who have
captured Asuka and Rei, and Koji, who has become
one with the Mazinger Zero. To save these three,
Shinji awakens Unit-01, and Tetsuya boards the
Mazin Emperor G. Koji takes the Mazinger Zero's
power for his own. Just when things seem to have
settled down, Embryo, Leonard, and Exev create a
space-time fusion, placing the world in peril.

The group prepares to journey to Iscandar to save
the world from the space-time fusion. All the
previously defeated Angels attack Shinji and the
others at NERV. Shinji boards Eva Unit-13 and
defeats the Angels with help from Asuka, Rei,
Mari, and a mysterious boy named Kaworu. There are
still many battles in his future, but Shinji's
will to fight is only strengthened.

As preparations for the journey to Iscandar are
underway, Huckebein and Grungust appear. Their
pilots attempted to join the crew.

Aid from the UC and AD dimensions arrive to join
the Tri-Dimensional Allied Fleet in the journey
to Iscandar. Seeking to prevent them embarking on
this journey, Embryo revives Dr. Saotome and
targets the Shin Getter Dragon. Ryoma and the
others realize what's happening and defeat them.
The Earth Federation and Neo Zeon cover the crew
as they jump to the New Correct Century dimension.

Traveling to intergalactic New Correct Century
makes the crew think of using subspace gates to
drastically shorten the journey to Iscandar. The
infamous Domel attacks the crew when they fall
prey to a Gamillan psychological assault. Gardim
also appears; one of its members is an old friend
of our hero, whose unclear intentions cause our
hero to avoid them.

The crew uses a subspace gate to arrive at Planet
Balun. Zoellik, who rose to power following
Dessler's demise, is waiting for them there with
Gamillas' main fleet. Okita is able to shake the
fleet off at Balun, and Zoellik is deposed by Goer
when he learns Dessler is alive and well. The crew
travels through Balun's gate and finally arrives
at the Large Magellanic Cloud, home to Iscandar.

The mechanics worry that there might not be enough
materials to get them through such a long journey.
Then elite Gamillan forces appear; the crew does
not let this opportunity go to waste and manages
to glean a large number of materials after the
battle, pleasing the mechanics. Nine gains a new
appreciation for all the people who support the
front line fighters.

The crew creates a Boson transmitter and receiver
in order to throw off the pursuing Gamillans, and
decides to split into two forces. Okita wishes the
best for everyone in the upcoming battle and sends
them off in hopes they will meet again.

For emergency purposes, Okita informs Bright about
his condition. As myriad feelings towards the
impending battle emerge, Setsuna considers not
fighting as an Innovator any longer. Berger, one
of Domel's underlings, attacks, and the group
encounters a mysterious metal life form. Their
assimilation abilities put the crew in danger;
Setsuna tries to communicate with them, but fails.

Krieze and Getto, two of Domel's underlings, trap
the crew in a flanked attack; Gardim launches an
assault as well. As they fight rock creatures, our
hero's old friend reveals they joined Gardim to
gain the power to revive the Earth. As the crew
fends off Gardim, Dessler orders Domel, who is
suspected of an attempt on the Supreme Leader's
life, to exterminate every last Earthling.

Zabine of the Jupiter Empire reaches Gamillas,
believing Dessler the pinnacle of aristocratic
rule. In order to win military prestige, Zabine
challenges Kincade to a final battle. The arrival
of Invaders creates chaos; Zabine's dreams are
scattered like space dust when he loses the fight.
The crew is close to Iscandar's Salezar System,
but decides to join up with the Nadesico Squad.

The crew shakes off Purple, who has followed them
this far, and lands on the planet Feldina. Purple
and the DG Alliance follow them. The crew is hard
pressed to fight against the Baptized Robot 
Army's Aura of Evil; Maito, shaken by what Purple
said, is placed in grave danger. Akito's faith in
heroes helps Maito recover, and they are able to
defeat both the Aura of Evil and Purple.

Kaname is possessed by Sophia once more after
being shaken by what Leonard said. When Cowen,
Stinger, Amalgam, and Gardim attack, our hero
learns that Gardim has the power to revive the
Earth, and that their friend joined Gardim in
order to gain such power. As the destruction of
Feldina begins, Sousuke faces off against Kalinin
and vows to rescue Kaname.

Exev and Mycenae, led by a shadow commander,
pursue the crew as they escape Feldina. Allying
with Wolfgang gives the crew Innocent Wave, which
lets them tear through the Aura of Evil. The power
of Sally's pureness defeats Exev and the Great
General of Darkness. With both these forces
destroyed, the crew rendezvouses with the Yamato
to head for Iscandar.

The crew and the Seven-Color Star Alliance battle
with Domel's forces. The crew fights desperately
against his army, but the arrival of Invaders
causes them to unite with Domel against this foe.
The crew wins a decisive victory against Domel,
but during this fight, a squad sent by Dessler
to capture Yurisha accidentally captures Mori.

Amidst misgivings about Iscandar's intentions, the
crew head to Planet Leptaporda to meet Melda. They
fight Cowen and Stinger, who are trying to absorb
the planet. Okita determines that Invaders are a
threat to life everywhere and decides to use the
wave motion gun to end this crisis. Kodai goes to
Leptaporda to rescue Mori, but she has already
been taken to Gamillas.

The crew arrives just as battle breaks out between
Gamillans and ELS due to Dessler using the Dessler
Cannon on a swarm of ELS. The crew aids Setsuna,
whose attempts at communicating with ELS are
successful. Now that they understand humans, they
stop fighting. Kodai and our hero break into
Baleras II and rescue Mori, but then Gardim
captures Nine and our hero.

A confrontation with Ahlforz leads our hero to
learn of the Civilization Reconstruction System
Nevanlinna, and that Nine is its terminal. Our
hero and Nine escape from Ahlforz and settle the
score with Ghuli. As Gamillas and Gardim battle,
Dessler attempts to destroy Baleras, but Okita
stops him by using the wave motion gun.

The group turns back toward Earth after obtaining
the Cosmo Reverse System from Iscandar. Dessler
attacks them and they escape, but Embryo then
transports them to True Arzenal. As a result of
their battle, they rescue some women and finally
defeat Embryo and Leonard. However, Mori is shot
during the fight and falls into critical
condition.

The Great General of Darkness sacrifices himself
to revive Hades, Lord of Hell, as the emperor of
darkness. Hades attacks the crew with Black Noir,
who'd been manipulating Exev and the others. The
crew counterattacks with Innocent Wave, consigning
this Great Evil to oblivion. Their enemies are all
defeated, but now the crew must stop the Cosmo
Reverse System, activated by Mamoru Kodai's will.

Gardim appears once again before the crew and the
three Earths. The 8th Fleet is summoned from a
time hole and attacks the crew under the command
of the true Ahlforz. The crew fends them off, but
Nevanlinna is revealed to be pulling the strings
from the shadows. After a hard-fought battle, they
defeat her. Okita sacrifices himself to activate
the Cosmo Reverse System, saving the three worlds.

critically wounded by Dessler, and Lacus is taken
by Embryo. After being transported to True
Arzenal, the crew learns the truth about Embryo's
immortality. They return to normal space, then
defeat Embryo and Leonard, who had been plotting
a space-time fusion.

After arriving on Iscandar, the crew meets with
Starsha. Though they had used wave motion energy
as a weapon, Starsha ultimately decides to entrust
them with the Cosmo Reverse System. Kodai bids
farewell to his brother Mamoru, who was laid to
rest on Iscandar, and then the crew turns back
to Earth.

Our hero and others aboard the Yamato are arrested
by security, who suspect they are stowaways.
Meanwhile, Huckebein and Grungust join the crew
after helping to defeat the Gamillan hostiles. As
the Yamato leaves the atmosphere, the fate of our
hero and the others remains undecided.

Velt and Lottie run into Gardim while out on a
reconnaissance mission together. Jamie appears as
well; Velt removes Huckebein and Grungust's
black hole engine limiters, and the two are able
destroy Jamie with their new power.
They return, however, to news of a crisis that
threatens the Earth and the cosmos alike.

With the space-time fusion caused by Aura's powers
barely prevented, the crew prepare to do what they
can to save the world. Huckebein and Grungust
evade Gardim and safely rendezvous with them to
add their strength on the journey to Iscandar.
